Name: (AT) Babies Take After Spouse
Author: peachygoose
Description:
An alternative texture version of Lakoria's Babies Take After Spouse, does not include seasonal outfits.

I made this as my farmer has more than 2 children with different spouses,
A.K.A it's compatible with Polyamory Sweet / Free Love.

Original Mod by Lakoria : https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/552
All credits go to Lakoria, I just converted it for alternative textures.
